correctness.rationale: The spring matrix is positive definite because its determinant is positive for positive mutual coupling and positive total pinning; full velocity damping makes the drift Hurwitz. Stationary covariance identities derive the exact current formula displayed in RESULT.md, and the two fixed budgets reduce flux optimization to a strictly convex quadratic in pinning contrast with an explicitly clipped minimizer. On the interior branch, the derivative has exactly the sign change at the universal damping threshold and a single possible positive minimizer; on the boundary branch, the derivative is strictly increasing. These facts prove all interior, boundary and critical cases, including uniqueness below threshold and precisely two mirror optima above it. The objective diverges when either positive damping tends to zero, excluding lost boundary extrema. An exact rational covariance check, 600 independent numerical Lyapunov comparisons, 180 one-dimensional optimizer comparisons and an exact radical witness passed. The infinite theorem rests on the full analytic proof, not finite tests.
